mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings, reporting that the thrust mains slipped into the cap and block groove far too easily and raising concern about the bearing spinning. The poster says a King technical representative told him the 2024 main bearings are out of spec.
